messages.subject: RATCH Group | Energy transition, ESG governance and regional execution
messages.body:
Dear Dr. Nitus Voraphonpiput,

RATCH Group's emphasis on energy transition, environmental policy, risk management and regional growth aligns strongly with the executive work I lead today.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities combine government and regulatory engagement, ESG, corporate coordination, social performance and executive stakeholder strategy within a major industrial operation.

My recent experience includes governance and external engagement around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage, carbon-data readiness based on physical operating records, and multi-agency coordination across environmental, energy and operational matters. I work where strategy meets regulators, communities, evidence and accountable delivery.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional mandates spanning ESG, External Affairs, Government Relations, Strategic Partnerships or Country Strategy. I have attached a RATCH-focused executive CV tailored to the company's current energy and sustainability priorities.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
